classification_legend.authoritative: Directly read or value-validated by a current domain owner; does not by itself establish a mechanic_id.

executor_direct_read_summary.organization: See authoritative and multi-consumer organization fields; four authoring-only fields remain unknown.

presentation_aliases.machine.effect_kind: kind, except facility table alias public_facility
presentation_aliases.player.name: display_name

presentation_payload_reads: product_id via recursive product-related-card lookup only

mixing_findings.finding: Hand slots contain a deep copy of all machine/player/developer static layers plus runtime_instance_id and later queue/lock flags.
Queued supply/demand cards receive _v06_automatic_target_context inside the card dictionary instead of a separate legal-action record.
Codex and region supply build separate flat aliases; table presentation only normalizes v0.6 facilities, so semantic aliases are not uniform across categories.
Commodity rate and facility HP/capacity/throughput values exist in payload but active execution derives them from rank/Ruleset or hard-coded owner behavior.

CATALOG_SOURCE.role: v0.6 Resource points to JSON source

CATALOG_VALIDATOR.role: identity, layer, payload and rank-ladder validator

COMMODITY_EXECUTOR.role: layered payload adapter reads product_id and industry_id

FACILITY_EXECUTOR.role: layered payload adapter reads facility_kind, card_rank, industry_id and allowed_region_states

FACILITY_RULESET.role: active rank profiles own HP, capacity, throughput, speed and warehouse values

GLOBAL_OWNER.role: authoritative supply/demand payload contract and execution planner

ORGANIZATION_OWNER.role: organization payload normalization and value validation

ORGANIZATION_TERMS.role: organization capability terms emitted from stored payload

UNIT_SCHEMA.role: unit execution schema reads family/rank fields

MONSTER_OWNER.role: real monster owner reads duration and ownership payload fields

INTERACTION_SCHEMA.role: uncomposed v0.6 interaction schema reads routing and response fields

LEGACY_AI.role: AI reads same-name flat v0.4 skill fields, not machine.effect_payload

COORDINATOR_PAYLOAD_HELPER.role: AI-labelled/coordinator facility helper reads three layered fields; no AiRuntimeController caller found

ROUTE_GATE.role: observed production v0.6 effect routing and unsupported fallthrough

CODEX_ALIASES.role: machine/player fields normalized into presentation aliases

PRODUCT_CODEX.role: presentation recursively searches payload values for product identity

INSTANCE_MIX.role: canonical static card copied into hand slot then receives runtime_instance_id

LEGAL_ACTION_MIX.role: legal target context injected into queued card dictionary

REGION_ALIAS.role: catalog layers normalized to region-listing descriptor aliases

RULE_COSTS.role: acquisition cash versus activation asset authority

RULE_ORGANIZATION_CLOSED.role: higher authority says organization cards are not yet open

RULE_MONSTER.role: monster summon and same-family upgrade semantics
